title: Tech that changed the world

slides.title: What is technology?
slides.text: Technology is anything people invent to solve a problem. A pencil, a bike and a tablet are all technology.

slides.title: Tech changes how we live
slides.text: The telephone let people talk from far away. Video calls let families see each other every day. Maps on a device changed how people find their way.

slides.title: Plus and minus
slides.text: Every invention is a tradeoff. It makes something easier and changes something else.
steps: plus: see your cousin far away
minus: you need a device and a connection

slides.title: People change tech too
slides.text: People change technology right back. Captions were added to videos because viewers asked for them.

words.means: anything people invent to solve a problem
you get one good thing but give up another

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Pick one invention you use every day. Think of one way it changed how people live, and one thing it made harder. Then talk about it.

talk: Which invention would you un-invent for a week? What would be better, and what would be worse?
